open_hypotheses: H1 (UZAVRETE): nikto v SK/CZ nezabral AI Act cl. 50 do 2.8.2026 - potvrdene, deadline presiel bez pokrytia.
H2: 'AI-assisted' sa stane pejorativom a 'AI-native' default narokom -> GR musi AI-Augmented Delivery aktivne obhajit. Podporene eskalaciou Vacuumlabs serie.
H3: Case studies s prevadzkovymi cislami maju vo fintechu vyssi efekt nez AI thought leadership.
H4: Recurring datovany format prekona jednorazove hlbkove clanky v celkovom vykone (Futured vzor) - overit po 3 cislach.
H5 (NEOVERENE, potrebuje LinkedIn pristup): CEO-led obsah (STRV Lubo Smid, Futured Lukas Strnadel, Panaxeo Igor Liska) ma vyssi engagement nez firemny profil.
H6 (NOVE): refresh existujuceho technickeho kusu s novym regulacnym/platformovym kontextom ma lepsi pomer effort/vysledok nez novy kus - overit na App Intents refreshi (W33-01).
H7 (NOVE): interne AI asistenty budu v regulovanom prostredi padat na pristupovych pravach, nie na kvalite modelu - overit dopytom z trhu po publikovani W33-02.
